director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Chalo, shuru karein?
pata nahi

Yahi sabse seedha tareeka hai jo mere paas hai, koi baat nahi. Cricket pitch: ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman theek beech mein ruka; us jagah ka bhi number hai. Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki 0 se 1 ke 3 gaps; 1/3 isi line par. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab line ke upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab line ke neeche dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, ek-doosre se ek jitni door. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, ek-doosre se ek jitni door. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

Line ke neeche marks ke beech ki khaali jagah gino, aur 0 ke baad wali aur 1 se pehle wali jagah bhi mat chhodna. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Ab line ke neeche dekho: wahan 7 marks hain, ek-doosre se ek jitni door. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: 8 barabar gaps

Bilkul sahi. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Gap zyada, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na

Haan, bilkul theek, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par hain. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal hum dono mil ke hal karenge.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao

Is patti ko raasta samjho: baayan kinaara ghar, daayan kinaara school, aur gaps ke beech ke teen marks teen khambe. Rangin gap ghar se pehle khambe tak ka raasta hai. Doori ke liye khambe ginoge, ya khambon ke beech ke gaps?
mujhe nahi pata

Doori gaps se naapte hain: khambe nahi, gaps, kyunki khambe jagahein hain, chalna gaps mein hota hai. Khambe raaste ko kaatte hain: 3 khambon se 4 barabar gaps, kyunki pehle khambe se pehle aur aakhri ke baad bhi ek-ek gap hai. Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1/4 kilometre

Haan, sahi hai. Dekho, 4 barabar gaps mein har gap 1/4 kilometre ka hai, aur pehla khamba 0 se theek ek gap par khada hai. Toh poora jawab: pehla khamba ghar se 1/4 kilometre door hai. 0 se 1 ki is line ko 10 marks ne barabar baanta hai. 0 ke baad pehla mark kaunsa fraction hai?

aapko virat pasand hai?

batting
Achha, toh tumhe batting sabse achha lagta hai. Ab apni padhai par lautte hain. Zoya ka kehna hai ki 1/11 line par 1/4 ke baad aata hai, kyunki 11, 4 se bada hai. Zoya sahi hai ya galat?

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/9 matlab 9 barabar gaps mein se 1 gap, toh 1/9 ki jagah 0 se ek gap par, pehle mark par hai. Ab 0 se ek se zyada gap chalenge, aur fraction ka upar wala number batayega kitne. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Ab upar wala number batayega ki 0 se kitne gap chalne hain. Yahan tak saaf hai?
haan

Is baar line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai, har gap 1/3. 0 se 2 gap chalo, ek, do, aur hum 2/3 par aa gaye. 2/3 ek hi jagah hai, ek hi number. Line ke neeche 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?
director.card: Line ke neeche 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: 8/5 sahi nahi hai. Line ke neeche 0 se ek-ek gap chalo aur paanch tak gino. Phir dekho, poore 1 tak aise kitne gap hain. Line ke neeche wale 8 barabar gaps par 0 se 5 gap chalkar kis fraction par pahunchoge?
director.card: Line ke neeche 8 barabar gaps hain. 0 se 5 gap chalo. Kis fraction par pahunchoge?

director.text: five eighths

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki har gap 1/8 ka, aur aise 5 gap mile toh 5/8. Line 3 barabar gaps mein kati hai. 0 se teen gap chalo toh theek 1 aata hai, isliye wahan 3/3 = 1. Teeno gap milkar 0 se 1 tak ki poori line bhar dete hain. 1/5 wale gaps dekho. 0 se theek 1 tak pahunchne ke liye aise kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: 1/5 wale gaps dekho. 0 se theek 1 tak pahunchne ke liye aise kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: 4 nahi, yeh jawab theek nahi baitha. 1/5 wale gaps par 0 se chalna shuru karo, aur har gap par ungli rakh kar gino, jab tak 1 na aa jaaye. Har gap 1/5 ka ho, toh 0 se theek 1 tak kitne gap chalne honge?
director.card: 1/5 wale gaps dekho. 0 se theek 1 tak pahunchne ke liye aise kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: Nahi, yeh theek nahi hai. Pizza ke 3 barabar hisse hon aur teeno le lo, toh poora pizza aa gaya: 3/3 ek poora hai. Line par bhi 3 mein se 3 gap chalkar hum poore 1 par hote hain. Ab phir se socho, jawab kya hoga?
director.card: 1/5 wale gaps dekho. 0 se theek 1 tak pahunchne ke liye aise kitne gap chalne honge?

director.text: 5 hai na

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/5 ke 5 gap milkar 5/5 banate hain, aur 5/5 = 1. Ab line ke 6 barabar gaps hain. Theek beech ka mark 3/6 hai, aur 3, 6 ka aadha hai, toh 3/6 = 1/2. 2/6 beech se pehle aata hai, 5/6 beech ke baad. Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Beech wale mark 3/6 se shuru karo. 4/6 tak pahunchne ke liye kis taraf ek gap chalna padega, woh dekho. Beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle

Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Roti ke 6 barabar hisse socho: 3 hisse le lo toh theek aadhi roti hai, isliye 3/6 = 1/2 beech mein hai. 2 hisse aadhi se kam hain, toh 2/6 beech se pehle, aur 5 hisse aadhi se zyada, toh 5/6 beech ke baad. Toh ab batao, kya aayega?
director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: before the middle

Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Beech wala mark 3/6 hai, teen gap par. 2/6 ke liye do gap chalo toh tum beech se pehle rukte ho, aur 5/6 ke liye paanch gap chalo toh beech ke aage nikal jaate ho. Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?
director.card: Isi line par 4/6 kahaan aayega: beech se pehle, ya beech ke baad?

director.text: baad mein

Haan, sahi hai, kyunki beech 3/6 par hai, aur upar wala number 4 usse ek zyada hai, toh ek gap aage, beech ke baad. Chalo, ab ek sawaal saath mein line par karte hain. Ek number line 0 se 1 tak hai. Is par 2/5 ka mark dhoondhna hai. 2/5 ka kaunsa number batata hai ki line kitne barabar gaps mein kategi?

seams.form: Chalo, ab ek sawaal saath mein line par karte hain.

director.text: bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
